components.name: Node.js tls sessions on default settings (Node.js 22)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All nine HTTPS client sessions on default settings: eight provider API calls in @auth/core (forwardemail, loops, mailgun, microsoft-entra-id, postmark, resend, sendgrid, todoist) plus the docs Footer GitHub fetch. Node 22 default TLS offers X25519/ECDHE key exchange and no post-quantum group — harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure on every OAuth/email API call; key-exchange agility belongs to the runtime, observable here.
